what: The GPU code of study 5's E2 top-up after the stream-prefix fix (the qualification of a reordered run stopped before its last step, and the launcher's end for the conflicts the earlier check wrote): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: No run trains under this code. The two GPU paths changed since pod 4's record qualify a run's terminal records (analysis.stage_a, which the launcher and the judge import) and write the launcher's journal ends (launch); the training, evaluation and replay paths are pod 4's, which pod 4's engineering check covers. The top-up's runs train at c6277f3177d2085b60348a147cd5687cfaa7453d, under pod 4's GPU code, a missing one by its own label alone. A run the earlier stream-prefix check refused stands as its observed outcome and is not trained again: under this code the launcher writes, in the journal of its attempt's start, the end it writes when an attempt ends (launch.run_campaign, "A conflict of the stream-prefix check"). A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
